real_bugs_found_and_fixed_during_this_ru: Turtle syntax error: bare numeric literals cannot carry an explicit ^^xsd:integer datatype suffix (`1^^xsd:integer` is invalid; `1` alone is already xsd:integer, or `"1"^^xsd:integer` if an explicit datatype annotation is wanted) -- fixed in beam4pm/ontology.ttl.

ggen's [FM-WRITE-002] guard refuses `../` path traversal in a template's `to:` target -- `to:` is resolved relative to the CONSUMING project's root, not the template file's own location -- fixed in all beam4pm-process-model-pack templates.

bpm:fieldRequired was authored as an ^^xsd:boolean-typed literal; normalized to a plain string literal ("true"/"false") so the Tera template's string comparison (`field_required == "true"`) is correct regardless of how any SPARQL engine happens to serialize a typed boolean.

A bare `rebar.config` src_dirs override with no OTP application resource file does not make modules loadable for `rebar3 eunit` (undef errors) -- fixed by adding a minimal hand-authored src/beam4pm.app.src (project scaffolding, not generated domain source) so rebar3 recognizes and compiles generated/erlang/src into the `beam4pm` OTP application.

Mix requires test_helper.exs to exist inside an explicitly configured test_paths directory -- rather than hand-authoring it under generated/ (which would violate the 'generated/ is 100% ggen output' invariant), added a 5th pack template that generates it from the same admitted graph.
